notes: TRIAL, NOT VALIDATED.  Glovebox BX53M, Olympus DP22 in raw mode (linear 12-bit mosaic, contrast mode 3, gains 1/1/1, black level shifted to 128), MPLN10x (NA 0.25; fitted with the tool's 0.30), no flat field.  Unsupervised fit (python -m flakeid.calibrate --tone flare --no-ccm --maxiter 60) to 30 tiles of one hBN chip on nominal 285 nm SiO2, 2026-11-15.  With it flakes are found, but the thicknesses bunch near 2 and 94 nm: do not trust them.  To be refitted with a flat field, whole scans and flakes of known thickness.
